## Decision-box entry: `needs-user-decision` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:records`. The 速读, the four-facet block and the prior-rulings line are completed here

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-28T16:55Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Prior rulings on this card: none on this thread. Related: objectui#10866's binding reading (release `5870108114`), 「a `datetime` keeps its instant」. It governs what a drop *writes*, which is why the seat asks rather than decides: every option but A changes the instant a datetime move writes.

### 维护者速读

月历视图里把一个带具体时间的日程拖到另一天,今天是按「两天午夜之间相差多少毫秒」来挪的。跨夏令时切换的那天,这个差是 23 或 25 小时,于是:
- 日程的钟点会差一个小时,10:00 变成 9:00 或 11:00。
- 午夜 0:00 的日程会落到前一格的 23:00。日历自己的「快速新建」就会写出这种午夜时刻,所以这不是边角数据。

中国大陆没有夏令时,所以国内用户基本碰不到。在美国、欧洲时区的用户每年会碰到两次。

| 选项 | 做什么 | 用户看到什么 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | 维持现状 | 跨夏令时拖动,钟点差一小时;午夜日程掉到前一天 |
| **B**(席位推荐) | 按「日历天」挪,保留钟点 | 10:00 拖到哪天仍是 10:00,和主流日历产品一致 |
| **C** | 只对午夜的值按天挪 | 修掉「掉到前一天」,但其余日程仍差一小时,而且会误伤真正在午夜的事件 |

**只问一字:A / B / C?**

### Four-facet block

- ① **Long-term:** B matches what the user did (moved an event to a day), and it would make the consumer-side day repair in `ObjectCalendar` redundant. A keeps an arithmetic that is wrong twice a year. C adds a heuristic.
- ② **Real pull:** a real defect, reproduced by contract review `5873110729` under America/Los_Angeles. It is reached by documents the calendar itself creates (quick-create writes local-midnight instants). Zero reach in zones without DST.
- ③ **AI-error:** none of the options makes an AI author write anything different. The difference is only what a drag stores.
- ④ **Startup focus:** B is a small `plugin-calendar` slice with zone pins (LA and Shanghai). A costs nothing. C is small but adds a permanent special case.

**Recommendation: B**, with A as the fallback. Only ① decides it; ②③④ do not flip it.

**Confidence gap:** the other calendar grids (week and day views) were not measured for the same arithmetic. If B is chosen, the slice measures them first.

Ruling: batch #241 item 2 · letter B · maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-29T01:21Z

Director seat (objectstack#12708, summon #30 续 2, `session_01AsCNgFBs8HCjwhyHQsFbx3`). Provenance: maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-29, replying 「同意」 to the presented batches #240, #241 and #242 together — this item recommendation B, fallback A, the full four-axis body in chat on 2026-09-28.

**Ruled: B.** The month grid moves a value by calendar days and keeps its wall-clock time, for every value. `MonthView.handleDrop` (`packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.tsx:673-678` today adds `newTargetDay − anchorDay` in milliseconds to the instant) computes the difference in calendar days between the grab cell and the drop cell and applies it with `setDate` on a local copy of the start and the end, hours / minutes / seconds untouched — for `move` and for `resize-end` alike. A (keep the elapsed-time arithmetic) and C (calendar days only for local-midnight values) are not taken. This is a deliberate change of the instant a drag writes; it changes nothing about what a `datetime` field stores or how it is read — objectui#10866's 「a `datetime` keeps its instant」 governs the binding, not the user's move.

Readings that decided it:
- Long-term: the user moved an event to a day, not by a number of milliseconds; the consumer-side day repair in `ObjectCalendar` (PR objectui#10994) becomes redundant. A keeps an arithmetic that is wrong twice a year; C adds a heuristic that misfires on real midnight events.
- Real use: a real defect, reproduced by review `5873110729` in America/Los_Angeles; the calendar's own quick-create writes local-midnight instants, so it reaches documents the calendar itself created; zero reach in zones without DST.
- AI-safety: none of the options changes what an author writes; only what a drag stores.
- Startup scope: a small `plugin-calendar` slice with zone pins; C would be a permanent special case.
- Mainstream: Google, Outlook and Apple calendars, FullCalendar and react-big-calendar all keep the wall-clock time on a month-view drag.

Execution parameters (ruled in the same stroke):
- This card → `pm:queue`; `domain:ui`, `priority:p2` stay.
- The slice measures the week and day views first; if their drop arithmetic is the same elapsed-time form, the same change rides the slice.
- Pins under `TZ=America/Los_Angeles` and `TZ=Asia/Shanghai`: a datetime moved across a DST change keeps its wall-clock time; a local-midnight instant lands on the dropped day; a date-only value is unchanged; a zone without DST behaves as before; `resize-end` follows the same rule.
- The `ObjectCalendar` day repair from PR objectui#10994 is removed once measured redundant, or kept with a comment saying why not.
- `Clause-②: no`; `@object-ui/plugin-calendar` patch changeset.

State: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `domain:ui`, `priority:p2` stay; the Ruled line goes on the body in the same stroke.

- `packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.tsx`: `MonthView.handleDrop`'s move and resize-end arithmetic, by calendar days with the wall-clock time kept; the week and day views are measured first and ride the slice if their drop arithmetic has the same elapsed-time form.
- `packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx`: the day repair from PR objectui#10994, removed once measured redundant, or kept with a comment saying why.
- Zone pins under `TZ=America/Los_Angeles` and `TZ=Asia/Shanghai`, and one `.changeset/11005-…md` (`'@object-ui/plugin-calendar': patch`). If this change falsifies a sentence of the pending `.changeset/10866-calendar-gantt-date-only-days.md`, it is reconciled here in the dated-note form.
- ⛔ Not `plugin-gantt`, and not objectui#10866 slice 5's other items.
Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (TIER_DEFAULT; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over this surface: no path-derived mandate, at objectstack `288611e3`)
Clause-②: no
Why no: the ruling's own execution parameter (`Clause-②: no`): a drag's written instant changes by ruling; no declared field shape, schema or accept set moves.

Serial constraints cleared: read 2026-09-29T01:47Z at objectui `origin/main` `0eb9f36`. Open PRs objectui#10930 (`core` dashboard filters, `types` `complex.zod.ts`), #10777 (`app-shell` `PageView.tsx`), #10278 (`plugin-grid` `ObjectGrid.tsx`) and #5400 (release): none touches `packages/plugin-calendar`. PR objectui#10994 (objectui#10866 slice 4) merged as `6650259`. objectui#10866 slice 5 (its `ObjectCalendar` mixed-event half and the shared pending changeset) is serial behind this card and is re-priced when it lands.
